description: This file defines a Lightning/Blits component 'Editor' used for displaying and editing notes within a note-taking application. It includes UI elements for editing note titles and content, as well as save and delete actions, with associated state management and event handling.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: A Lightning/Blits component for editing and managing notes, including UI rendering, state handling, and user interaction methods.

methods.name: $emitSave
methods.description: Emits a save event with current note buffers, signaling to save the note.

methods.name: $emitDelete
methods.description: Emits a delete event for the current note.

methods.name: $toggleTitleEdit
methods.description: Switches the focus to or from editing the title.

methods.name: $toggleBodyEdit
methods.description: Switches the focus to or from editing the note body.

calls: $emit('save', { id: this.localId, title: this.titleBuf, content: this.bodyBuf })
